sample: Matched NAAMP pairs in which all ten StopNumbers have nonmissing identical SiteID in wet and dry runs.
decomposition: Exactly the existing CallingIndex total = activation + deactivation + shared-positive intensity decomposition.
model: Exactly the existing rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber model with route-clustered covariance.
pass_rule: Use the existing threshold-dominant rule unchanged: total beta >0; activation beta 95% CI entirely >0; activation contribution >50% of total beta; activation beta > shared-positive intensity beta.
interpretation: A pass shows the CallingIndex recruitment pattern does not require stop relocation. It does not identify the physiological mediator.
